title: Resolution prediction
prompt: Overload pairs teach betterness. Implement class `Solution` with `static string Pick(int v)` returning "int", `static string Pick(long v)` returning "long", `static string Pick(object v)` returning "object", and `static string Pick<T>(T v)` returning "generic". Callers in the tests pass literals of different static types; your implementation just labels which overload is chosen by the test's own calls.

tests.name: literal-types
tests.hint: Exact-type match beats generic inference; T fixed by the call site beats object.
